messages:
maria: quick RFC follow-up on hosting abstraction. I sketched minimal runtime vs control-plane breakpoints. posting questions.

ryan: paste the sketch?

maria: short version: control-plane = catalog, routing, rollout rules. adapter/runtime = execution, batching, cache, local secrets handling.

keisha: agree with separation. main open Q: who performs tenant KMS resolution for Private? control-plane or adapter?

maria: leaning adapter for isolation. adapter can perform local KMS unwrap and hand back a short-lived claim to control-plane.

ryan: if adapter does unwrap we need attestable proof. propose Attestation {adapter_id, nonce, expiry, sig}. control-plane validates adapter pubkey.

keisha: +1. also require handshake version fields so we can evolve. handshake_version + capability_manifest_v.

maria: capability manifest should be tiny: batching_cap, streaming, max_seq_len. control-plane uses it for routing.

ryan: errors: adapters return small stable set: ERR_CAPACITY, ERR_TEMP_OVERLOAD, ERR_AUTH, ERR_UNSUPPORTED. include retry_hint seconds.

keisha: metrics: adapters see token counts. For Private, customer may block outbound. adapter should support local sink + signed aggregate counters for reconciliation.

infra-bot: Created INF-1720: "Adapter handshake + attestation" and linked thread.

maria: action items: ryán -> shim prototype (2w), keisha -> security appendix (4d), maria -> update RFC (2d). ping when PRs exist.

ryan: noted. will prototype minimal handshake types.

keisha: will draft attestation requirements and key rotation notes.

maria: OK closing. thanks.
